Generic hit strip, used for reaction types that have no hit_type_N strip. hit_type_1 is the ordinary type the table selects for the most common contact (hit-pose-selection-2026-10-04.md); it is a standing flinch, so launch types 5 and 6 look upright until their own selector evidence exists.

Koma 5 slot B is "Nano-Slicer" (repo:docs/research/guides/systems/koma-list.json); the kit special_sets koma 5 up X move is UP_X@k5, and its anim id 0x2c is asset bc_b_01 anim 0029 + 3. Reviewed frames match. Hair spiral; the kit mash move (anim 0x2c, 84 frames) is the 84-tick track.

Reviewed frames match. Fists fan out across the whole screen height; the kit mash move (anim 0x29, 39 frames) is the 39-tick track.

Koma 5 slot A is "Transformation - Lance" (repo:docs/research/guides/systems/koma-list.json); the kit special_sets koma 5 X move is X@k5, and its anim id 0x2b is asset bc_b_01 anim 0028 + 3. Reviewed frames match. Winged lance thrust; the track runs 112 ticks, the kit whiff path returns at 85 and the tail past tick 86 is a branch the library does not select.
